verdict.rationale: Whisper is a speech-to-text model, CLI, and API. It takes audio in and returns transcripts or translations; it does not reason or invoke tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows any tool-calling or MCP client capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
